# Money, banking and purchases

**Historical study:** [Cash, procurement and liquidation](../docs/historical-studies/what-retreat-cost.md).

## Cash supply and denominations

The crown requests specify wages and purchases in Hungary, delivery by aircraft and a suitable supply of small notes. A complete parallel reception restores the ending of the daily airlift instruction.

| Subject | Summary | Page editions |
|---|---|---|
| **Thirty million crowns requested for wages and purchases** | Thirty million crowns are requested for wages and purchases in Hungary, by giant aircraft to Brasso, with a mixture of large and small notes. | [p. 167](../cases/pages/167.md#source-p167-b1) |
| **One million crowns daily by ordinary aircraft** | The request proposes one million crowns daily by ordinary aircraft, alternating between Kronstadt and Hermannstadt. Its interrupted ending concerns small banknotes. | [p. 174](../cases/pages/174.md#source-p174-a1) |
| **The complete small-banknote instruction** | A complete reception establishes the instruction to send notes as small as possible and corrects one earlier conjecture about the interrupted ending. | [p. 195](../cases/pages/195.md#source-p195-a2) |

## Remittance, payout and guarded transport

The Vienna–Kronstadt bank-transfer message asks whether local payment succeeded. Later correspondence concerns a guarded rail alternative, access to an advance at Arad and continuing banknote shortages.

| Subject | Summary | Page editions |
|---|---|---|
| **An initial five-million-crown transfer through Vienna** | The message announces an initial five-million-crown transfer by the Wiener Bankverein to Kronstadt in mixed denominations. The recipient is asked whether local payout succeeded and was sufficient. | [p. 205](../cases/pages/205.md#source-p205-a1) |
| **A guarded rail alternative for Hermannstadt cash** | If the Döberitz aircraft has not departed, cash is to travel under special guard by train through Szolnok and Arad to Hermannstadt, with arrival notices. | [p. 216](../cases/pages/216.md#source-p216-b1) |
| **Arad advances and partial crown remittances** | An Arad request asks about access to an advance; a separate message reports partial crown remittances and a severe banknote shortage. Their transactions cannot be equated. | [p. 219](../cases/pages/219.md#source-p219-a1) |

## Procurement cancellation and resale

ZITAG orders distinguish further commitments from consignments already paid for. Silk purchases are to be resold where removal is uncertain; a separate Odessa instruction seeks a wagon sale on the best possible terms.

| Subject | Summary | Page editions |
|---|---|---|
| **Purchase stop-orders and the paid-consignment exception** | Stop-orders halt further buying and loading. A separate instruction permits loading paid consignments, cancels other contracts and requests Westernhagen’s return. | [p. 96](../cases/pages/096.md#source-p96-a) · [p. 102](../cases/pages/102.md#source-p102-a) · [p. 103](../cases/pages/103.md#source-p103-b1) · [p. 106](../cases/pages/106.md#source-p106-b) |
| **Local resale of silk when transport is uncertain** | Silk and related Caucasus purchases are to be resold locally where removal cannot be assured. Parallel receptions establish the complete disposal instruction. | [p. 136](../cases/pages/136.md#source-p136-b1) · [p. 144](../cases/pages/144.md#source-p144-a2) · [p. 152](../cases/pages/152.md#source-p152) |
| **The Odessa wagon-sale request** | An Odessa-routed request seeks the best possible terms for selling wagon Magdeburg 9910. The damaged adjacent phrase does not securely identify its contents. | [p. 201](../cases/pages/201.md#source-p201-a1) |

## Allowances and currency redemption

Allowance instructions and exchange correspondence concern the terms on which money could be paid or redeemed. The lei negotiations distinguish stamped from unstamped notes, while several numerical rate fields remain unresolved.

| Subject | Summary | Page editions |
|---|---|---|
| **Military allowance instructions** | The message calls for lower cash meal allowances, communal purchasing and food in kind, and rejects a cost-of-living supplement. | [p. 129](../cases/pages/129.md#source-p129-b1) · [p. 133](../cases/pages/133.md#source-p133-a2) · [p. 134](../cases/pages/134.md#source-p134-a4) |
| **Negotiations over stamped and unstamped lei notes** | The sender seeks amounts, denominations and stamping details for lei redemption and proposes bank arrangements. Negotiations and several exchange-rate values remain unresolved. | [p. 223](../cases/pages/223.md#source-p223-a1) |
| **Ruble prices and payments above par** | The conditional reading reports 140 marks per 100 Tsar rubles in Kiev and up to 190 in Warsaw, and recommends payments above par for BONS if necessary. | [p. 171](../cases/pages/171.md#source-p171) |
